assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the supplied complete KAIJU case file. Restyle this entire raster dossier into a modern, polished CORPORATE incident-report document. Preserve the monster photograph subject, case identity and every factual field/order. The WHOLE FILE remains a single image, all typography and evidence included.
Visual direction: a premium corporate security/risk report prepared by a contemporary organization. Crisp white and very light cool-grey document stock, deep navy text, precise Swiss editorial grid, modern neo-grotesk sans-serif typography, consistent alignment, generous clean margins, thin grey rules, one restrained muted amber accent for this case. Small corporate wordmark text 'BOSCALI INCIDENT FILES' in a navy header. Classification 'EYES ONLY' as a clean rectangular printed label. Case number 'BSC-0313' cleanly aligned top right. Large bold 'KAIJU' title, medium-weight metadata, clear FIELD ORDERS section. Large professional evidence photograph on the left around38%width, sharp rectangular edges and a subtle grey caption rule. Right-hand typography hierarchically composed and readable at 480px-wide in-game display. A real corporate DOCUMENT, not app UI, and it must still read as a case dossier.
Remove all vintage styling: no weathering, distressed type, sepia, aged folder, wax, torn corners, paperclips, photo corner mounts, rubber stamps, hazard tape, military crests, parchment, grunge or scorch. No interface buttons, control widgets, luminous panels, dashboard charts or invented prose. Keep minimal physical paper realism with a clean nearly rectangular complete silhouette.
Canvas: exactly landscape1536x1024,3:2, flat orthographic front-on scan, document fills canvas with a very narrow transparent margin. Preserve existing alpha outside the document; no tabletop/backdrop or cast shadow. No cropped edges or distorted photograph.
Text verbatim: 'BOSCALI INCIDENT FILES'; 'BSC-0313'; 'EYES ONLY'; 'KAIJU'; 'TYPE'; 'ABYSSAL TITAN'; 'LAST SEEN'; 'SEA FLOOR'; 'FIELD ORDERS'; 'STRIKE ALL 21 WEAK POINTS.'; 'THE HEART OPENS LAST.'; 'KEEP IT AWAY FROM AIRBASES.' Optional tiny photo caption only 'EVIDENCE / 01'. Use a clean modern corporate sans-serif, not slab-serif or typewriter. Body/order lettering minimum44px at1536px source width so it remains readable when scaled to480px. The photo stays an immense spined sea-floor monster with a submersible floodlight for scale.
assets.edit_source: Original vintage BSC-0313 dossier; original generation exec-89ddd2df-2892-49a7-a4fc-f252a757e179.png

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Two input images: Image1 is the OLD case dossier to edit, whose evidence photograph subject and factual contents must be preserved. Image2 is the NEW corporate KAIJU report, the exact VISUAL DESIGN reference. Rebuild Image1 as the matching corporate report in the same series as Image2. The entire case file, including all text and photo, remains ONE finished raster image.
Match Image2 closely: crisp nearly white/light-grey report stock, dark navy header, modern neo-grotesk corporate sans-serif, identical top brand/header hierarchy and aligned case number at right, photo left around38%width, clear large title and metadata at right, FIELD ORDERS lower right in a navy section header, thin grey rules, clean document rectangle, narrow safe border, flat orthographic scan. Keep all orders unusually large and readable at480px render width; at least44px source body type at1536px. Corporate incident dossier, not dashboard. Printed 'EYES ONLY' label as in design reference. Same small double-slash identity in the top bar. Use a single restrained accent colour as specified below. No vintage textures, torn edges, folder tabs, paper clips, military crests, grunge, distressed/typewriter/slab-serif fonts, rubber stamp marks, photo mounts or scorch on the document. No extra prose, UI buttons, interactive widgets, cast shadows or background desk. Photo can retain its evidence grain, but document and type must be pristine.
Canvas exactly landscape1536x1024,3:2. Preserve alpha outside the complete rectangular paper silhouette. Preserve the entire report uncropped with all typography baked into image. No dynamic encounter status or summon/banish controls in artwork.
Accent colour: muted cool blue, matching a personnel/risk report. Exact text: 'BOSCALI INCIDENT FILES'; 'BSC-1987'; 'EYES ONLY'; 'FALLEN ACE'; 'TYPE'; 'PHANTOM INTERCEPTOR'; 'LAST SEEN'; 'HANGAR 4'; 'FIELD ORDERS'; 'CLOSE TO GUN RANGE.'; 'DEFEAT ALL THREE LIVES.'; 'DO NOT ANSWER ITS CALLS.'; photo caption 'EVIDENCE / 01'. Keep the original visor-down anonymous pilot beside a jet in a misty hangar as the photo. Face stays hidden. Very large bold title, orders prominent like reference.
